## Applied, verified changes

1. **Type hierarchy:** Standard slide headings enlarged from ~22.3 to **25.5 pt**, the three-line title slide to **25.4 pt** with enlarged text box and reflow clearance, closing to **30 pt**. Sidebar headings from 12 to **14.1 pt**; explanations from 11.3 to **13.2 pt**; editable foot/source labels from 8.8 to **9.6 pt**.
2. **Scoped ASU typography choice:** **Arial for institutional/prose/engineering labels** in this derived ASU presentation; **Times New Roman retained selectively for mathematical formula notation**. This is a scoped new-copy implementation of official-ASU-compatible presentation prose and does *not* silently edit the global Deck3 Times New Roman rule.
3. **Short copy instead of shrinking:** Rewrote the right column slide-by-slide for precise three-point readability, with compact source/evidence qualifiers. No new research conclusions added and frozen objective authority remains unchanged.
4. **Presentation geometry:** Title-slide block lengthened and illustration placed below it; two conceptual natural-color illustrations retained on Slides 1 and 3, each explicitly disclosed as conceptual art, not an observed thesis installation.
5. **Scientific diagrams 2,4,5,6,7,8,9,10:** Maintained **native scalable Google Slides geometry and text**. Larger figure labels and improved spacing; reduced heavy outlines on the research-roadmap, methodology-first-stages, evidence and timeline/closing components; retained meaningful causal/supply arrows and evidence-aware interface semantics.
6. **Architecture Slide 5:** P1→P2→T1 remains AC, T1→T2 DC. P3 protection not serial. P4 (cooling technology still OPEN), T3 EVSE cooling, T4 HVAC are separate. Condensed main equipment labels into two lines and increased available box heights. External heat H(t) separate from a claimed causal interdependency. No fictional forced-air oil-cooling assumptions.
7. **Evidence Slide 7:** Three *independent* evidence streams, increased visual metric types to ~22–24 pt and added separating rules: Bærug 8,592 records / reported held-out 0.907 K MAE, TU Wien 20Cable, and reported Qatar commercial 50 kW charger 86→169-min comparison for its studied conditions. No fake scatter graph; no integrated cross-site validation claimed.
8. **Assessment Slide 8:** Maintained required electricity and mobility **conditions to test**, conditional thermal mechanism, no mandatory recovery chain, and separate heat/reference versus intervention/heat sustainability comparisons.
9. **Brand audit:** The live Google Slides API structural QA verified ten slides, source ASU master `p20`, approved native authored palette only (13-token Deck3 registry), all three editable sidebar headings at 14.1pt and three bodies at 13.2pt. White diagram interiors, minimal gold structural accents, and authentic depicted-object colors confined to the two conceptual illustration raster assets.
10. **Resolution policy:** Native vector diagram text/lines are scalable without raster degradation. The original ~1672×941 illustrations on Slides 1 and 3 remain raster; they were *not* falsely represented as 4K native photos, nor were they replaced by invented field imagery.

## Explicit remaining QA gates / scientifically bounded claims

- **Native full-screen pixel review NOT RUN:** Google Slides thumbnails were returned by the connector, but the thumbnail image bytes were not available to the model for a trustworthy image-by-image inspection. Thus slide-by-slide rendered text wrapping, line collision, ASU live-caption overlay and projector-size readability remain OPEN; no false final release approval.
- Google Slides source asset rights/photo provenance are not newly established; images on Slides 1 and 3 are AI-generated conceptual artwork, not actual authorized equipment photos.
- Recalculation of the Bærug results, review of 20Cable source code, and independent verification of Qatar measurements were not performed in this visual-design operation.
- Candidate T_e→P / P→T_e temperature-mediated interdependencies, qualified cross-system data, required-service thresholds and measured sustainability consequences remain unverified/Open.
- The Google Slides file is not auto-synchronized with previous PPTX derivatives.
- Do not merge/publish institutional template binaries, nor claim that this design change independently validates scientific propositions.

**Release status:** Finished editable **visual redesign working copy**, with full-screen scientific presentation QA still OPEN. Keep distinct earlier deck versions intact.
